detailed_descriptions.en: The Gothic 1 Remake soundtrack is composed by the legendary Kai Rosenkranz who created the Gothic 1-3 soundtracks to great acclaim. The soundtrack is rooted in the original Gothic, bringing back many familiar themes and melodies, newly recorded to a high artistic standard. Moreover it features many new tunes to further strengthen the atmosphere of the penal colony of Khorinis.
